tools.name: get_offroad_trail_list
tools.title: Show Offroad Trail List
tools.description: Searches onX Offroad for a list of offroad trails, routes, or roads matching the provided filters and renders an inline results widget with trail names, technical ratings, length, elevation, and photos. Use when the user asks for a list of offroad trails, routes, or roads. Do NOT use for hiking trails, ski trails, campgrounds, points of interest, or other entity types. If the user says "near me" or similar, send the approximate location you already know for the user as location.near (city level is fine) and put their city in searchedPlace. Ask the user where to search only if you genuinely have no location for them. Difficulty requests ("easy", "moderate", "difficult", "extreme") go in technicalRating as integer bounds, never in q. For follow-up requests that refine an earlier search in this conversation ("show me only the easy ones", "shorter ones", "show more") you MUST re-send the SAME location object and searchedPlace you used in the previous call - do not drop them.

q.description: OPTIONAL text search over trail names, descriptions, and features. Use for a trail name ("Hell's Revenge") or a distinctive feature ("scenic", "rock crawling", "water crossing"). Do NOT put difficulty words here (easy, beginner, moderate, intermediate, difficult, hard, extreme) - those MUST go in technicalRating. Do NOT include generic terms like "offroad trails" or "4x4 trails" - omit this parameter entirely for general location searches.

distance.description:
CRITICAL: Distance MUST be in METERS, NOT miles or kilometers! DO NOT pass the raw number from the user query - you MUST convert it first!

CONVERSION FORMULAS:
- Miles to meters: multiply by 1609 (e.g., 50 miles = 50 × 1609 = 80450 meters)
- Kilometers to meters: multiply by 1000 (e.g., 50 km = 50 × 1000 = 50000 meters)

COMMON CONVERSIONS:
- 10 miles = 16090 meters
- 25 miles = 40225 meters
- 50 miles = 80450 meters (RECOMMENDED DEFAULT)
- 100 miles = 160900 meters
- 50 km = 50000 meters
- 100 km = 100000 meters

EXAMPLES:
✅ CORRECT: User says "within 50 miles" → distance: 80450
❌ WRONG: User says "within 50 miles" → distance: 50

MINIMUM: 80000 meters (approximately 50 miles) - smaller values will be rejected.

location.description: Where to search. REQUIRED for every search except a pure name lookup via q - never call with filters and no location. Geocode named places to lat/lon (e.g. "near Moab" → lat 38.5733, lon -109.5498) and send the name in searchedPlace; if you know the place but not its coordinates, send searchedPlace alone and the tool resolves it. Distance MUST be in meters (50 miles = 80450m). For follow-up requests that refine an earlier search in this conversation ("show me only the easy ones", "shorter ones", "show more") you MUST re-send the SAME location object and searchedPlace you used in the previous call - do not drop them.

searchedPlace.description: The place the search is for, as the user named it (e.g. "Moab, Utah", "Moab", "near Sedona"). ALWAYS include this whenever you send location. When location is omitted, the tool resolves this name to coordinates itself, so include the state for ambiguous names ("Springfield, MO"). Echoed back so follow-up calls can carry the same place; re-send it together with location on refinements.

technicalRating.description: Filter by technical difficulty rating, an INTEGER from 1 (easiest) to 10 (most extreme). ALWAYS use this (never q) when the user mentions difficulty. Map words to ranges: "easy"/"beginner" → { lte: 3 }; "moderate"/"intermediate" → { gte: 4, lte: 6 }; "difficult"/"hard" → { gte: 7, lte: 8 }; "extreme" → { gte: 9 }; "rated under 5" → { lt: 5 }; "rated 6" → { eq: 6 }.

allowedWidths.description: Filter trails by the vehicle width class they allow. Send an array of class names. Map the user's vehicle to a class: FIFTY_INCH = vehicles no wider than 50 inches - ATVs, quads, smaller UTVs and side-by-sides; SIXTY_INCH = vehicles no wider than 60 inches - larger UTVs and side-by-sides (SxS); common in newer trail systems; SINGLE_TRACK = narrow trails usually no wider than 24 inches - off-highway motorcycles and dirt bikes; HIGH_CLEARANCE = at least 72 inches wide but needing 8-10 inches of ground clearance - high-clearance 4x4s and trucks, not standard passenger cars; FULL_WIDTH = at least 72 inches wide (often 80-96) - standard passenger vehicles including sedans and low-clearance 2WD/AWD; forest service roads, BLM improved roads, county roads; SNOWMOBILE = trails that accommodate snowmobiles.

between.description: Range filter with min and max

length.description: Filter trails by length. Values MUST be in METERS. Convert from miles: multiply by 1609.34. Examples: "under 10 miles" → lt: 16093, "over 20 miles" → gt: 32187, "5 to 15 miles" → between: { min: 8047, max: 24140 }.

bestSeasons.description: Filter trails by best seasons to ride. Use when a user asks for trails good in a specific season or time of year. Values: SPRING, SUMMER, FALL, WINTER. Examples: "best winter trails" → ["WINTER"], "spring and fall trails" → ["SPRING", "FALL"].

lat.description: Latitude the search was centred on

lon.description: Longitude the search was centred on

distanceMeters.description: Search radius actually used, in meters

For follow-up requests that refine an earlier search in this conversation ("show me only the easy ones", "shorter ones", "show more") you MUST re-send the SAME location object and searchedPlace you used in the previous call - do not drop them.

needsLocation.description: True when the search did not run because no location was supplied and no place name could be resolved. Re-send the earlier location, or ask the user where to search.
